# @heswell/trading-schemas API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/api-reference.ts from the TypeScript source. Do not edit: run `bun run docs:api`. -->

The client entry of `@heswell/trading-schemas`: table definitions, enums, RPC contracts and validation, tick / lot maths. Shared by the UI, the servers and the in-browser engines. Overview: [schemas.md](../schemas.md), [package README](../../packages/trading-schemas/README.md).

Imports: `@heswell/trading-schemas`. 296 exports. Types are shown as written in the source; defaults come from `@default` tags or the component's destructuring defaults.

*function* · [domain/ticks.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/ticks.ts#L95)


#### validateOrder

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L156)

```ts
validateOrder(order: OrderToValidate, instrument: InstrumentStatic, phase: TradingPhase = TradingPhase.Continuous): OrderReject | undefined
```

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L71)


#### validateQuantity

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L52)

```ts
validateQuantity(quantity: number, instrument: Pick<InstrumentStatic, "lotSize">): OrderReject | undefined
```

#### validateStopLimitPrices

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L109)

A STOP_LIMIT must be able to fill when it triggers: a buy's limit at or

```ts
validateStopLimitPrices(side: Side, price: number, stopPrice: number): OrderReject | undefined
```

#### validateStopPrice

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L90)

An INVALID_STOP_PRICE reject unless `stopPrice` is > 0 and on the
instrument's tick schedule.

```ts
validateStopPrice(stopPrice: number, instrument: Pick<InstrumentStatic, "tickSize" | "tickBands">): OrderReject | undefined
```

#### validateStopTrigger

*function* · [domain/orderValidation.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderValidation.ts#L129)

A stop must not already be reached: a buy stop above the market price, a
sell stop below it. `marketPrice` is the last trade (else mid / reference);
no check without one.

```ts
validateStopTrigger(side: Side, stopPrice: number, marketPrice: number | undefined): OrderReject | undefined
```

#### DAY_MS

*const* · [domain/session.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/session.ts#L12)

Session time and the intraday volume curve, shared by exchange-sim (which
scales bot activity by the curve) and the OMS (whose VWAP strategy follows
the same curve).

"Clock" times are ms since the epoch. "Session" times are the time of day
of the (possibly compressed) trading day: with `dayMs` < 24h a whole
simulated day passes in `dayMs` ms of clock time, so session durations are
scaled by `dayMs / DAY_MS` when converted to clock durations.

```ts
const DAY_MS: 86400000
```

#### ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS

*const* · [domain/orderStatus.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderStatus.ts#L20)

Allowed OrdStatus transitions, shared by OMS (which enforces them) and UI
(which uses them to decide e.g. whether amend/cancel are offered).

Conventions:
- An order always starts in PENDING_NEW and is acknowledged (NEW) or
  REJECTED before any fill is reported.
- IOC/FOK remainders and DAY orders at session end become EXPIRED.
- A cancel/replace reject returns the order to its working status
  (NEW / PARTIALLY_FILLED / REPLACED).
- Fills may race a pending cancel/replace.
- REPLACED is a working status: the order was amended and remains live.
- FILLED, CANCELLED, REJECTED and EXPIRED are terminal.

This is only the transition table; the full reducer (quantities, exec
reports) lives in the OMS (Phase 2).

```ts
const ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS: Readonly< Record<OrdStatus, readonly OrdStatus[]> >
```

#### TickBand

*interface* · [domain/ticks.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/ticks.ts#L9)

Tick and lot utilities shared by the order ticket, price ladder, OMS

#### VolumeProfileParams

*interface* · [domain/session.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/session.ts#L21)

Shape of the intraday volume curve over the continuous session. The
activity multiplier at session fraction f (0 = open, 1 = close) is
`base + curve * (2f - 1)^2 + openSpike * e^(-f/width) + closeSpike * e^(-(1-f)/width)`,
normalised to average 1 over the session.

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | `number` |  |  |
| `curve` | `number` |  | U-shape: extra weight towards both ends of the session. |
| `openSpike` | `number` |  | Extra activity just after the open. |
| `closeSpike` | `number` |  | Extra activity just before the close. |
| `spikeWidth` | `number` |  | Width of the open / close spikes, as a fraction of the session. |

#### RpcName

*const* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L40)

RPC contracts. All trading RPCs are sent as RPC_REQUEST with
VIEWPORT_CONTEXT (any viewport on a table of the target module) and are
registered server-side with DefaultRpcHandler.registerRpc.

Params are flat (Vuu restricts RPC params to string | number | boolean).
Success: SUCCESS_RESULT with the typed `data` below.
Failure: ERROR_RESULT whose errorMessage is `"<RejectReason>: <text>"`
(see formatRpcError / parseRpcError).

```ts
const RpcName: Readonly<{ readonly CreateOrder: "createOrder"; readonly AmendOrder: "amendOrder"; readonly CancelOrder: "cancelOrder"; readonly CancelAll: "cancelAll"; readonly SetVolatility: "setVolatility"; ... 21 more ...; readonly SetFlowParams: "setFlowParams"; }>
```

#### runScenarioParams

*const* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L311)

`args` is a JSON object overriding its default args.

